ttm.shares_basis: latest quarter's diluted weighted-average count (not all four quarters filed)

dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividends_paid.basis: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements) + buybacks (1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — a lower bound) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buyback_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: neither bound — a positive leg and the issuance leg are both incomplete

legs.dividends_paid: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements
legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: neither bound — a positive leg and the issuance leg are both incomplete

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

buyback_yield.label: ≥ 0.00%
buyback_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound

net_buyback_yield.label: ≈ 0.00% (incomplete)
net_buyback_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound; share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

shareholder_yield.label: ≈ 0.00% (incomplete)
shareholder_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound; share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

notes: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

dividends_paid_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed dividends_paid figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30) — the tag was never filed in any period, so the leg counts as zero
buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
